description: The SANSA Earth Observation online catalogue is the searchable catalogue of the Earth observation imagery archive of the South African National Space Agency for South Africa and the Southern African Development Community (SADC) region. The catalogue was funded by the Department of Science and Innovation and developed by Kartoza. The page links related SANSA services: DESA, which turns raw high-resolution satellite data into ready-to-use data; a decision support tool; the Mzansi Amanzi water site; the Fundisa student portal with remote sensing resources and a forum; a remote sensing atlas; and the SA-GEO and NEOSS pages. Browsing the catalogue is open online; the terms for ordering imagery and any licence are not stated on the page read. Caveats: the page read is the catalogue front page, so the missions, dates and ordering conditions have to be checked in the catalogue itself, and the copyright line dates from 2022. Coverage is South Africa and the SADC region. It supports hazard exposure analysis and land change mapping around infrastructure, such as flood, drought and fire monitoring with archived imagery; related records are the MYSA open data catalogue and Digital Earth Australia.
